name: clarify_tool_flatten_choice
notes: Traced copy of src/tools/clarify_tool.c::clarify_flatten_choice; LIVE twin tools/clarify_tool.py::_flatten_choice. SCOPE NOTE: src/tools/clarify_tool.c has no clarify_tool.h and cannot be linked standalone, so this is a faithful traced copy. Inputs restricted to the agreed subset where the flat C key-scan agrees with LIVE's recursive flattener: plain strings, flat objects with non-blank canonical values, arrays of plain non-blank strings. Divergences excluded: whitespace-only dict values (C keeps then empties them, LIVE skips), bool/null/number scalars (C prints 'true'/''/'%g', LIVE prints 'True'/'None'/'str(i)'), nested lists/dicts inside arrays (C does not recurse).
